title: jsPsychRmsPlugin
description: A jsPsych plugin for Repeated Masking Suppression (RMS) and breaking RMS (bRMS) paradigms in web-based experiments. Includes plugins for jsPsych 6 (jspsych-brms.js) and jsPsych 7 (jspsych-brms-7.js).
